defs.def: to continue to live or exist 生存；存活；继续存在

ex.s: “If these restaurants don’t survive, Chinese culinary traditions in our city won’t survive.” she says.
ex.t: 如果这些餐厅倒闭了，我们城市的中国烹饪传统也会随之消亡。

ex.s: Presenting the best of the West End along with the pick of the UK’s touring shows, the New Theatre is Cardiff’s oldest surviving traditional theatre.
ex.t: 呈现西区最佳剧目以及英国巡演精选，New Theatre是卡迪夫现存最古老的传统剧院。

ex.s: The world won’t survive if this situation continues.
ex.t: 如果这种情况继续下去，世界将无法承受。

ex.s: The Xi'an City Wall is the most complete city wall that has survived China's long history.
ex.t: 西安城墙是中国悠久历史中保存最完整的城墙。

ex.s: Love of family helps us survive great hardships.
ex.t: 家庭之爱帮助我们度过艰难困苦。

ex.s: To survive in the forest, animals must climb, jump or fly across the gaps.
ex.t: 为了在森林中生存，动物们必须爬过、跳过或飞越这些空隙。

ex.s: Soil surrounding the sequoia in its original location was relocated as well, because trees are more likely to survive a transplant when they move with their original soil.
ex.t: 红杉原址周围的土壤也一并迁移，因为带着原土移植，树更可能存活。

ex.s: The more we know about this lovely creature, the greater the chance it will survive and keep its place in the natural world for a long time to come.
ex.t: 我们对这种可爱的生物了解得越多，它就越有可能生存下来，并在未来很长一段时间内保持其在自然界的地位。

ex.s: Nautilus: Fossil records indicate that the nautilus has survived relatively unchanged for around 500 million years.
ex.t: 鹦鹉螺：化石记录表明鹦鹉螺在约5亿年间相对没有变化地存活了下来。

ex.s: This tiny organism can survive temperatures from 150 °C to a below freezing -272 °C.
ex.t: 这种微小的有机体可以从150°C到低于冻度的-272°C的温度中生存。

ex.s: That project, which I could complete from my sofa instead of in the burning heat of the desert, not only survived the lockdown but worked where traditional methods didn’t.
ex.t: 那个项目我可以坐在沙发上完成，而不必在沙漠的酷热中进行，它不仅在封锁期间存活了下来，而且在传统方法不起作用的地方发挥了作用。

ex.s: Read these tips on hurricane safety so that you and your family can survived this common threat to coastal cities.
ex.t: 阅读这些飓风安全提示，这样你和你的家人就可以在这种对沿海城市的常见威胁中生存下来。

defs.def: to continue to live or exist despite a dangerous event or time 幸存；幸免于难；渡过难关

ex.s: When she was 50, she survived an emergency surgery.
ex.t: 她50岁时，挺过了一场紧急手术。

ex.s: Which website can you visit to learn about Cardiff’s oldest surviving theatre?
ex.t: 你可以访问哪个网站了解卡迪夫现存最古老的剧院？
大多数人挺不过这一关。

defs.def: to live or exist longer than sb/sth 比 … 活（或存在）的时间长

ex.s: Then I’ll be able to survive even when the tall buildings are flooded.
ex.t: 那么即使高楼被淹了，我也能活下去。

chunks.cn: 是 能够 去 生存
可能性 它 将 生存
抛弃 不 仅 生存
